events.title: Semantic verification of universal survival on a named subcube already contains UNSAT
construction: Compile arbitrary CNF H(X) to frozen-B2 output h.
Choose roots p,q with crossing support and define g <-> (p AND q).
Define target e <-> ((NOT h) AND g).
Use the codimension-zero region R=*^n containing every full assignment to X.
events.formal_identity: Every alpha in R leaves e CROSSING iff H is UNSAT.
events.complexity_statement: SEMANTIC_UNIVERSAL_FULL_CUBE_SURVIVAL is coNP-complete on this polynomial reduction image; a falsifying alpha is a polynomial complement witness.
events.meaning: A region name plus an instruction for the verifier to semantically check all points is not a cheap proof-carrying robustness certificate. A separate derivation must be carried.
scope_firewall: This is a complexity reduction, not an unconditional superpolynomial time lower bound.
The restriction distribution is abstract/uniform, not Sokolov source-matched self-reduction.
events.next_gap: Require a proof-carrying region certificate rather than semantic universal checking.

events.title: Exhaustive search over inverse-polynomial-measure subcubes is not polynomial
formal_statement: The number of codimension-k subcubes over n roots is exactly C(n,k)*2^k.
A subcube of measure at least N^{-c} may have k<=c log_2 N.
On state families with n=Theta(N) and k=Theta(log N), C(n,k)*2^k = exp(Theta((log N)^2)) up to lower-order log-log factors.
Therefore enumerating every polynomial-measure subcube and applying a polynomial verifier is superpolynomial/quasipolynomial in the worst case.
events.scope_firewall: This lower bound applies to explicit exhaustive region enumeration, not to every possible direct region constructor.
required_object: polynomial-size proof Pi of required robustness on all rho in R
explicit measure lower bound for R
events.next_gap: Construct or refute a direct polynomial proof-carrying robust-region constructor that does not enumerate the quasipolynomial region vocabulary.

events.title: Independent RSPC-LB subcube finite-mechanics replay passed
events.meaning: Provider CI confirms only the named finite full-cube identity and subcube-count mechanics. coNP-completeness and quasipolynomial exhaustive-search growth remain analytical results.
events.next_gap: Attack the proof-carrying robust-region constructor itself: region discovery, robustness-proof discovery, and global-potential accounting must all be polynomial without semantic or exhaustive fallback.

active_front.name: AKINATOR-RSPC-PC
active_front.current_exact_question: Can syntax/graph structure directly generate, in deterministic polynomial time, a polynomial-measure restriction region together with a polynomial-size proof that the required crossing/inversion resource survives throughout that region, and can repeated such moves be charged to one fixed polynomial global potential?
forbidden_shortcuts: proof verification silently substituted for proof discovery
finite region counts promoted to asymptotic theorem
